title: Doss
desc: Rajeshwari and Antony, a young couple, have major class differences. She decides to elope after father kills her sister for marrying a man from a lower caste.

title: Arumugasamy
desc: A priest and his daughter are exiled after temple jewels go missing. The village head later discovers the priest's innocence and searches for him.

title: Laysa Laysa
desc: Chandru's grandfather is going to visit him but Chandru has spent all his money. So he requests his wealthy friend, Rakesh, to pose as the owner of all the riches till his grandfather stays with him.

title: Kanaa Kanden
desc: A young man comes up with a dream plan to help society, but he lacks the funds to complete the project. However, things take a turn when he meets a man who promises to finance his project.

title: Arima Nambi
desc: Anamika gets mysteriously abducted while on a date with Arjun. However, when Arjun goes to the police for help, he lands in a dangerous situation.
